Are you looking for a dynamic role in a fast-paced environment where your work ethic is truly valued? Join the BPO Services team in Breda as a warehouse worker! You will help power our international supply chain while building a reliable career.
Ready to get hands-on and make things happen? Discover what this position has to offer you below.

What we offer
- Earn € 2,596.03 per month!
- € 0.23 travel allowance per kilometer
- A  7-month contract with consistent work hours
- Enjoy our comfortable breakroom and modern canteen
- Opportunities to get a permanent contract
- A work environment rated with a 8+

Who you are
We are searching for reliable, energetic warehouse worker who enjoy staying active during work.

- Flexible to work in a 3-shift pattern (mornings, afternoons, and nights) for at least 3 days per week (21+ hours, Monday – Friday).
- Comfortable standing, walking long distances, and handling parcels up to 23 kg throughout your shift.
- Good understanding of either English or Dutch.
- Possess your own reliable means of transportation to reach our location in Breda.

What will you do
As a warehouse worker, you will be key to managing incoming and outgoing shipments bound for the Netherlands, Belgium, and France.

What a typical day looks like:

- Unload incoming containers efficiently to maintain continuous workflow.
- Position packages onto advanced automated sorting platforms.
- Securely build and prepare shipping containers for daily cross-border transport.
- Verify destination zip codes and shipping tags to prevent sorting errors.
- Keep the sorting areas organized and safe alongside your teammates.

Where will you work
BPO Services is a rapidly expanding logistics service partner known for a direct, informal, and down-to-earth culture. We take pride in creating a vibrant work atmosphere where diversity is celebrated and hard work pays off.

As a Reachtruck/or Forklift driver at Samsung SDS in Tilburg, you will make sure that all products get to the right place. You work in a multinational team where you will quickly feel at home.

In the warehouse you are constantly on the move. You load and unload trucks with precision and speed. With your reach truck or forklift you drive through the aisles to pick or put away products. You stack items neatly, so everything is stored efficiently.

Cooperation is important in this job. You consult with colleagues to make sure the work runs smoothly. Together you ensure that all orders are ready for shipment on time.

You work 37.5 hours per week in two shifts: from 06:00 to 14:30 or from 14:30 to 23:00. 

Are you ready to get started in this modern distribution center? Then apply now and become part of the Samsung SDS team!

You enjoy being active and like variety in your work. As a reach truck or forklift driver at Samsung SDS, you'll make sure everything gets to the right place.

What you bring:

- You speak good English. So you can easily communicate with your colleagues.
- You have a good physical condition. The work can be heavy at times.
- You are available full time and can work both shifts 
- You have your own accommodation and transport

It is an advantage if you can also work on weekends. This way you help the team when it is extra busy.

Do you have a passion for creating high-quality products that seamlessly combine design, functionality, and innovation? Please note this is not an active vacancy; we are building a talent pool for future Product Development roles at a leading global fashion and lifestyle brand.
In this role, you’ll turn creative concepts into reality—developing products that align with market needs, sustainability ambitions, and brand values. Join our talent pool and be among the first to discover exciting upcoming opportunities.

- Ensuring that quality and sustainability standards are met through thorough testing and collaboration with production teams.

- Monitoring market trends and customer insights to help shape product development strategies.

- Supporting seasonal planning, contributing to line reviews, and presenting product updates to key stakeholders.

- You have experience in Product Development, Apparel Development, or a related field, ideally within the fashion, retail or lifestyle industry.

- You have excellent communication skills in English (written en verbal).

- You possess strong knowledge of materials, fabrics, and production techniques.

- You are familiar with PLM systems (e.g., Centric PLM) and other tools for product management.

- You have exceptional organizational skills and can manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

- You have excellent communication and collaboration
